leveling.earlyRowsNote: The widest early-row gaps by removal, a row's worth on the vanilla side less the same row's on the rebuilt side, in points of the build's output, the eleven widest and the four widest the other way. Whole rebuilt early rows that read nothing in the instrument: Enhancement's gates 0, 5 and 10 at every level (Stormbringer's extra attack on the melee tag, unread by the white swing; Elemental Cadence's cooldown multiplier on spells a level-20 shaman does not cast; Guardian Totems), Arms' Poise, Retribution's Sanctified Blessings and Seal Mastery, Subtlety's Initiative and Camouflage, Marksmanship's Steady Aim, Shadow's Blackout, Frost's Frostbite and Deep Freeze; a granting talent (Aimed Shot, Pyroblast, Mind Flay) reads nothing by the stripped method because the grants list stands, and by forbid Aimed Shot is 47 to 50 points of a hunter's build at 20 on either side.
leveling.note: The card's example is the Warrior: at 20 it reads -3.7%, and its vanilla first row (Cruelty, Improved Rend, 6.9 points by removal) against the rebuilt (Bloodletting, Poise, 1.3) is where the gap is; the depth curve at eleven of thirty-one points does not close it. Where the rebuilt side leads early it is one clause: Mage +39.7% at 20 is Improved Fireball's vulnerability on a mage who casts nothing else, Priest +29.0% at 30 is Shadow Affinity's refresh (Shadow Word: Pain never lapses, the unconditioned refresh of stage H's finding on the vanilla side too), Druid +26.1% at 30 is Natural Shapeshifter's opening window and Rend and Tear, Warlock +20.6% at 30 is Improved Corruption's instant cast and Improved Immolate's consume. The widest early-row gaps: Warlock at 40, gate 0, +20.7 (Improved Shadow Bolt, Cataclysm and Suppression, 34.8 points, against Improved Corruption and Familiar, 14.2); Mage at 40, gate 5, +16.5 (Arcane Concentration and Ice Shards, 16.5, against Frostbite and Deep Freeze, which read nothing); Hunter at 40, gate 0, +12.0 (Efficiency, 12.0, against Steady Aim, an attack speed add the instrument does not read); Rogue at 20, gate 0, +11.1 (Improved Sinister Strike and Malice, 12.8, against Opportunity, 1.7). Two findings outside the card: given 1.12 effects the vanilla trees read below the rebuilt trees at 60 in every class under one block, which nothing pinned, since the band compares 31 / 20 with 30 / 21 and the calibration scaled the block on rebuilt builds; and the greedy selector's level-60 best builds improve when a talent it valued is forbidden (Conflagrate and Destructive Reach, Improved Mind Blast and Mana Burn, each +38.9%), which the banded cells do not see. Bare, without the curve, four classes read below vanilla at 20 (Rogue -10.1, Warrior -6.3, Shaman -5.6, Hunter -2.3). This stage measured and did not tune: whether the early rows are retuned, and by which lever (the rows that read nothing, the curve's shape, or nothing if 5.6's back-loading is the intent), is the owner's, and any retune is a stage with a stage 0 on every banded cell. The row cap moved four anchors and two mid rows without a text or an effect changing, since the hill-climb buys against gates: Warrior 40 and 60 read +18.7% and +18.2% where they read +16.0% and +16.6% (Second Wind out of Arms' seat, the points on Mortal Cleave and Sure Strike); Priest 60 reads +7.8% where it read +21.0%, because the Shadow 31 build buys Silence at gate 25 before Darkness's fifth rank and the class's best rebuilt shape at 60 on patchwerk is Shadow 26 / Discipline 25 (Priest 40 stands, the hill-climb forbidding Silence there); Paladin 60 reads +8.1% where it read +7.7%, Retribution 30 / Holy 21 with Sanctified Judgement's first rank now the best rebuilt shape; and the Mage rows read +25.9% / +24.8% at 30, +16.0% / +21.6% at 40 and +36.3% / +72.3% at 60 where they read +33.5% / +26.6%, +20.9% / +29.9% and +38.0% / +74.4%, the Frost 21 shapes buying Frost Channeling's fourth rank and, after stage M's retune, reading its discount on Blizzard alone. Every other row is to the digit.
